evidence.description: requestAPNConsent directly uses UIApplication.shared to register for remote notifications.
makeNotificationCenter obtains the global notification center and configures its categories and delegate.
Delegate callbacks directly invoke the operational Analytics.shared.brazeIAM service.

candidates.explanation: BrazeService directly obtains operational services through singleton access rather than an explicit, replaceable dependency boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: The non-actor class declares mutable braze and notificationAuthorizationStatus properties and exposes the instance through public static let shared.
initBraze assigns braze synchronously and also accesses it from a MainActor task, without isolating the owning class.
The asynchronous status retrieval writes notificationAuthorizationStatus without synchronization or actor isolation.

candidates.explanation: BrazeService exposes mutable instance state through its static shared instance without actor isolation or synchronization. Its Braze reference and notification authorization status are modified through instance methods without a common protection boundary.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation

evidence.description: BrazeService is a mutable reference type without Sendable conformance or actor isolation.
The MainActor task captures self through delegate assignment and braze access; the initiating method continues with updateID after scheduling the task.
updateID reads braze and can invoke changeUser on it, retaining access to the same state used by the MainActor task.

candidates.explanation: initBraze captures the non-Sendable BrazeService instance in a MainActor task while retaining conflicting access in the initiating region. The task accesses the mutable braze property, and the synchronous method continues by calling updateID, which also accesses that property. No ownership transfer or isolation boundary protects these accesses.
candidates.title: Non-Sendable Value Crossing an Isolation Boundary
